exit_criteria: Every H2-R2 electrical claim checkable without fabricated hardware has reproducible evidence.
Every failed margin is corrected in its source artifact and all dependent evidence is regenerated.
Every model input has authoritative provenance, tolerance and applicability limits.
Every remaining uncertainty is physical-only and assigned to H5, H6 or H8.
No H3 result authorizes purchasing, PCB placement, routing or fabrication.
